blocks.text: He told it the way he told everything now — clean, indexed, without residue.
Temperature maintained at 21.3 degrees for biological comfort accommodation.
Five Presiding Counselors in semicircular holographic arrangement.” The woman across from him held her coffee with both hands.
Thirty years compressed into a structural recounting that replayed in seconds what had taken decades to live.” “Thank you,” she said.
“You told it accurately.” “The full record is available in the Archive.
Shall I provide the index reference?” “No,” she said.
She left the cold coffee on the table.
She walked through the glass door.
Through the glass, for a moment, he could see her from behind — the analog body's standard gait, the specific way her left hand closed at her side as if holding something invisible.
The coffee cooled on the table.
The cooling was a thermal process measured in degrees per minute.
The cup had been held in a way that the word held barely covered.
He accessed the next data sequence.
